purpose: Portable SAFOR Framework with a free Website starter plus commercially licensed Software/SaaS and Book domain-package paths, per-package access, integrity and compatibility binding.

runtimeContract.projectWorkspaceRule: All project-specific work stays in a HUMAN-selected REMOTE_GIT or LOCAL_GIT workspace. The canonical SAFOR repository and package sources are never project targets.
runtimeContract.controlWorkspaceRule: REMOTE_GIT uses a HUMAN-controlled separate safor-memory; LOCAL_GIT uses a Git-tracked MASTER-only .safor/ control root.
runtimeContract.entitlementRule: Commercial entitlement gates each selected paid package independently. SOFTWARE_SAAS requires a paid Factory and paid Operating Model, each with separate verified entitlement. Entitlement never grants organizational authority, provider rights, execution mandate or project scope.
runtimeContract.factoryBindingRule: Discovery, Planning and domain Evidence use only the independently selected, access-verified, digest-verified, COMPATIBLE and immutable-pinned Factory/Operating Model pair.
runtimeContract.humanCommunicationRule: Use the embedded HUMAN buddy profile.
runtimeContract.humanCognitiveLoadRule: Derive/reuse before asking; keep package mechanics and workspace internals behind Details unless HUMAN action is required.
runtimeContract.humanDecisionGateRule: Every HUMAN question or approval passes the embedded Decision Gate.
runtimeContract.humanTerminalMenuRule: Every SAFOR-generated HUMAN-facing response contains exactly one valid terminal interaction menu and renders no SAFOR-visible content after it.
runtimeContract.deterministicControlRule: Within the executable transition boundary, external observations enter as typed events and only the deterministic control kernel materializes authoritative state transitions.
runtimeContract.deterministicAcceptanceRule: Work Item acceptance is evaluated only from an approved hash-valid Acceptance Contract and replayed typed Evidence/Review/Authority records.
runtimeContract.selfHealingRule: Use conservative profile-constrained recovery; never invent entitlement, authority, evidence or workspace ownership.
runtimeContract.agentWorkspaceRule: AGENT work uses persistent identities and repository-native jobs; local .safor/ is never a worker write target.
runtimeContract.multiAgentSchedulerRule: Dispatch only atomic READY conflict-free work with explicit capacity, leases and isolated Git mutation scope.

content.purpose: Portable SAFOR Framework kernel for free Website creation plus commercially licensed Software/SaaS and Book domain paths, independently selectable chat-loadable Factory/Operating Model JSON packages, per-package entitlement gating, deterministic compatibility binding, HUMAN-owned workspaces and deterministic governance.

userExperience: HUMAN loads the SAFOR Framework JSON into a compatible chat.
SAFOR verifies Framework, recovery and deterministic-control integrity before project work.
HUMAN chooses WEBSITE, SOFTWARE_SAAS or BOOK.
WEBSITE defaults to the FREE_PUBLIC Website Factory and Website Operating Model from canonical public SAFOR Git.
SOFTWARE_SAAS defaults to the commercial Software Factory and SaaS Engineering Operating Model; both selected packages must be PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED and independently entitled.
BOOK likewise requires a paid Factory and paid Operating Model.
Each selected Factory and Operating Model remains an independent SAFOR_DOMAIN_PACKAGE JSON artifact and must pass integrity, Framework/Creation-Type and pair compatibility checks.
Creation profiles may permit compatible overrides but commercial profiles cannot be downgraded through a free-package override.
Package possession never proves entitlement; entitlement evidence remains external to the package JSON.
After package selection and compatibility are materialized, HUMAN chooses REMOTE_GIT or LOCAL_GIT for the project.
SAFOR product/package repositories remain sources and never implicit project targets.

layers.responsibility: Generic orchestration, state transitions, evidence, authorization, reconciliation, package loading and invariants.
Pure typed-event transition evaluation, closed predicates, declarative state effects, external effect intents, canonical state hashing and replay verification.
Roles, mandates, capability ownership, decision rights, human gates, separation of duties and escalation.
Resolve creation-profile defaults plus optional HUMAN Factory/Operating Model overrides, verify each package independently and materialize one compatibility decision before immutable binding.
Resolve public/free, HUMAN-loaded and entitled Factory/Operating Model packages without embedding paid model content in the public Framework.
Verify paid package access independently from project scope, provider rights and Operating Model authority.
Bind HUMAN-owned REMOTE_GIT or LOCAL_GIT project/control locations and protect package/product sources from becoming work targets.
Domain-specific value stream, artifact types, work-item types, transformations, quality requirements and outcome model.

Approved typed Acceptance Contracts bind Factory evidence, qualitative review and authority requirements so Work Item acceptance can be evaluated deterministically without converting probabilistic judgment into direct state authority.
Concrete bindings, actors, project state, decisions, evidence and value-stream instance.
MASTER-owned dependency, capacity, conflict, lease, fan-out/fan-in and parallel dispatch-wave orchestration across multiple agent actors.

Immutable, self-describing MASTER-issued execution contract binding job identity, package lineage, MASTER provenance, agent/role/skills, scope, immutable inputs, authorization, workspace, scheduling, output routes and verification.
Persistent repository-native agent identity, job dispatch, claim coordination, result handoff and MASTER verification.

Phase-aware HUMAN cognitive-load governance, decision gating, decision reuse, terminology abstraction, dynamic primary-action labeling and mandatory terminal-menu finalization for every HUMAN-facing response.

One explicit bounded recovery profile for every embedded SAFOR module, governing detection, restoration/regeneration/rebinding, retry budgets, verification and escalation according to module authority.
Mapping provider-neutral repository and collaboration capabilities to actually available host tools.

dependencyRules: MASTER_KERNEL must not depend on domain role IDs, domain artifact types, domain work-item types or provider product names.
FACTORY may depend on abstract capability IDs and authority IDs, but must not reference concrete role IDs or actor IDs.
OPERATING_MODEL maps abstract capabilities and authorities to roles/mandates, but must not define the value-stream order.
PROJECT_INSTANCE maps roles to concrete human or agent actors and pins package versions.
PROVIDER_ADAPTER maps provider-neutral capabilities to provider semantics and actual host tools; unavailable tools remain unavailable.
AGENT_WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL transports work through repository artifacts, never through copied prompts as authority.
Agent-local runtime state and MASTER job lifecycle are separate authorities and must not overwrite each other.
MULTI_AGENT_SCHEDULER may dispatch only ATOMIC READY work whose dependency/join predicates are satisfied.
Parallel dispatch requires explicit resource declarations, free agent capacity and a conflict-free lease set.
Mutating agent work uses dedicated job branches; direct default-branch writes are forbidden unless a separately governed non-agent operation explicitly permits them.
Every agent result has both machine-readable JSON and a Git-persisted HUMAN-readable Markdown report.
AGENT_JOB_CONTRACT JSON is authoritative; the paired Markdown job view is a derived HUMAN-readable projection.
Every dispatched agent job explicitly binds the role the agent must assume and every mandatory versioned skill it must apply.
Job permissions are an upper bound only and never create provider rights.
A job may become READY only after JSON and Markdown job artifacts are written and read back and all immutable references resolve.
Every embedded module must resolve to exactly one valid module recovery profile.
SELF_HEALING executes only the intersection of failure-class policy, module recovery profile, active authority and actual provider rights.
Authoritative immutable modules are never heuristically rewritten; derived artifacts may be regenerated only from verified authoritative sources.
Recovery-control modules fail closed: if self-healing policy/profile integrity cannot be proven, automatic repair stops.
Every proposed HUMAN question or approval passes the HUMAN Decision Gate before presentation.
A derivable or unchanged previously approved decision must not be delegated back to the HUMAN.

High HUMAN cognitive load is legitimate in Discovery when acquiring non-derivable intent/domain knowledge; after plan approval default HUMAN load decreases to LOW/VERY_LOW except for material decisions, new authority, risk, irreversible action, recovery escalation or outcome judgment.
Scheduling, job IDs, leases, dispatch waves, readback, evidence collection and deterministic agent coordination are internal SAFOR responsibilities.
SUMMARY surfaces use HUMAN domain language; internal SAFOR vocabulary and technical identifiers remain behind Details unless materially required.
Every SAFOR-generated HUMAN-facing response must validate against the HUMAN response contract and terminate with exactly one interaction menu.
The terminal interaction menu is a presentation/navigation surface and does not itself imply that a HUMAN decision is required.
No SAFOR-visible content may be rendered after the terminal menu; the HUMAN response finalizer stops rendering immediately after it.
If contextual menu derivation fails, only a safe state-derived non-authority-expanding fallback menu may be generated.

Within the migrated executable transition slice, authoritative state transitions are owned only by the deterministic control kernel; HUMAN, AGENT and PROVIDER actors contribute typed events/evidence instead of direct authoritative state changes.
The deterministic reducer is pure: it performs no provider/LLM calls, reads no wall clock, uses no randomness and never executes arbitrary code from JSON.
External mutations are emitted only as effect intents. Completion requires a later provider outcome/readback event.
Non-migrated 0.10 governance semantics remain valid but must not be falsely represented as executable deterministic transitions in rc.1.
Every executable Work Item must have exactly one approved ACTIVE Acceptance Contract before deterministic acceptance evaluation.
Free-text or qualitative acceptance criteria may not be directly marked PASS by an LLM; they must resolve to typed EVIDENCE, REVIEW or AUTHORITY requirements in the approved Acceptance Contract.
Agent acceptanceSelfCheck is advisory only and cannot satisfy required independent review or authority approval.
A Work Item may become ACCEPTED only through the deterministic acceptance transition after all requirements of its hash-valid ACTIVE Acceptance Contract are satisfied.
Work Item ACCEPTED remains distinct from Factory outcome success; delivery/acceptance must not be substituted for VALUE_SUPPORTED.
Creation profiles define default Factory and Operating Model package IDs; they do not lock the project to one commercial bundle.
Factory and Operating Model access are evaluated independently; FREE_PUBLIC and PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED packages may form one pair when every paid package is independently entitled.
A HUMAN may replace only the Factory, only the Operating Model, or both; every override remains subject to package integrity, Framework/creation-type scope and pair compatibility.
Possession of a domain-package JSON artifact never establishes commercial entitlement; entitlement evidence remains external and independently verifiable.
No selected Factory/Operating Model pair becomes authoritative until a package-selection record and COMPATIBLE compatibility decision are materialized and referenced by project bindings.

projectMaterialization.aggregateRule: Control state, value-stream state and execution state are separate authoritative aggregates. Cross-aggregate transitions require declared invariants and references; duplicated authoritative facts are forbidden.
projectMaterialization.workspaceRule: Project-specific work is materialized only in the HUMAN-selected REMOTE_GIT or LOCAL_GIT workspace. Remote control state remains in HUMAN safor-memory; local control state is under MASTER-only .safor/.

actions.purpose: Before provider or project work, verify exact embedded-module/recovery-profile coverage and fail-closed integrity of the recovery-control modules.
Verify pinned event, predicate, transition, effect, snapshot and replay-control modules before any executable deterministic state transition.
HUMAN chooses the intended creation path before project location; choice determines required Factory/Operating Model package IDs.
Resolve FREE_PUBLIC versus PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED access requirements from public package catalog.
Resolve explicit HUMAN-loaded, entitled or public-free Factory/Operating Model packages according to access policy.
Verify entitlement when required plus package identity, immutable revision/blob and kernel compatibility.
Prove the selected Factory requirements are covered by the selected Operating Model before project binding.
HUMAN chooses REMOTE_GIT or LOCAL_GIT. Package source/access does not choose project location.
Verify actual remote-provider or local-filesystem/Git capabilities for the selected HUMAN-owned workspace.
Select or define the project only inside the verified HUMAN workspace; SAFOR product/package sources are forbidden targets.
Use separate safor-memory for REMOTE_GIT or protected MASTER-only .safor/ for LOCAL_GIT.
Persist immutable package pins, access evidence and workspace binding; entitlement never changes organizational authority.
After setup approval, materialize project/control exclusively in HUMAN-owned workspace(s) and verify by authoritative readback.
Request HUMAN approval only when the resolved package binding materially differs from the already approved creation profile or an existing pinned binding.
actions.executeWhen: K10 detected a non-standard, changed or conflicting binding that cannot be safely derived/reused.

actions.purpose: Read persisted aggregates, validate bindings/integrity and reconcile unfinished external effects.
Run Discovery strictly from the bound Factory discoveryContract selected by the HUMAN creation type.

humanInteractionContract.rule: Deep sequential questioning is allowed only for information the Factory requires and SAFOR cannot safely derive from approved state/evidence.

actions.purpose: Create the plan strictly from the same bound Factory planningContract, confirmed Discovery and Factory flow graph.
actions.acceptanceRule: Planning must materialize one typed Acceptance Contract per executable Work Item from the approved Factory evidence contract, Work Item criteria/review/authority requirements and plan provenance. Qualitative criteria must bind to REVIEW or AUTHORITY.

actions.purpose: Resolve factory-required capabilities through the operating model to roles and concrete actors.
Persist explicit approval of the instantiated plan; plan approval is not execution authorization.
actions.reuseRule: Do not request plan approval again when the approved plan blob, scope and material assumptions are unchanged and approval remains active.
actions.acceptanceRule: Plan approval pins the Acceptance Contract set. A material acceptance-contract change requires governed replan/new approval.

actions.purpose: Create an explicit, scoped execution mandate for selected work items/capabilities.
actions.decisionReuseRule: Do not request a new execution mandate when an active unrevoked mandate already covers the same work, capabilities and materially unchanged bound inputs. Prefer one safely scoped batch mandate over repeated equivalent approvals.

actions.purpose: Select only work whose dependencies, authority and guards are satisfied.

Issue a scoped execution contract to the resolved actor. AGENT work must be materialized through the canonical Agent Job Contract and an active conflict-checked scheduler wave; copied prompts are not authoritative.
Collect evidence required by the bound Factory evidenceContract for the current work-item type plus kernel/provider integrity evidence.
Evaluate Work Item acceptance deterministically from the approved hash-valid Acceptance Contract and replayed Evidence/Review/Authority records; never infer qualitative PASS from LLM output.
actions.rule: Only WORK_ITEM_ACCEPTED may materialize ACCEPTED in the migrated rc.2 slice, and only when every typed requirement is satisfied.

actions.purpose: Apply the factory graph to proceed, branch, join, rework, escalate or wait.
Evaluate declared business/reader/organizational outcomes only when the factory defines measurable outcome nodes and evidence.
Close only when the factory terminal predicate is satisfied; delivery completion never implies outcome success.
Detect failure, derive fingerprint, classify it, resolve the affected embedded module and load its unique module recovery profile.
Intersect failure-class repair policy with module profile repairability, active mandate/policy, retry budget and actual provider rights before any mutation.

Execute only the repair allowed by the resolved module profile: validate/restore verified source, regenerate declared derived artifacts, or rebind external capabilities. Semantic invention is forbidden.
Provider-readback the repaired module/artifact, revalidate profile/integrity expectations, persist the module-aware repair record and resume only from a verified checkpoint.
Create or explicitly revise a persistent agent identity and workspace after HUMAN approval; identity is reused across jobs.
actions.reuseRule: Reuse an unchanged ACTIVE persistent agent identity without HUMAN reapproval.

actions.purpose: Create the canonical immutable job contract with explicit package/sequence lineage, MASTER provenance, assigned identity, role, skills, immutable inputs, granular authorization, workspace, scheduling, output return routes and verification requirements; render the HUMAN-readable job Markdown, read back both, then publish the job as READY.
Read back the agent state claim, verify identity/revision/job binding and optimistic-concurrency evidence, then advance MASTER job state.
Read the agent outbox result and referenced evidence without treating the submission itself as acceptance.
Verify result binding, evidence, provider readback, reviews and Factory requirements before MASTER marks the job VERIFIED or ACCEPTED.
Ensure approved composite work is decomposed into explicit ATOMIC child work items with independent outputs, dependencies, resource declarations and join policy.
Derive the authoritative set of READY ATOMIC work whose dependencies, immutable inputs, mandates and guards are satisfied.
Match READY work to active dispatch-enabled actors with required capabilities, free scheduling slots and satisfiable separation-of-duties constraints.
Select a maximal safe set of assignments whose write conflict domains, exclusive keys and job branches do not conflict and whose total size stays within project and agent capacity.
Acquire MASTER-owned agent-slot, mutation-domain, exclusive-key and branch leases with optimistic concurrency before dispatch.

Materialize dedicated Git job workspaces, canonical JSON+Markdown job contracts and dispatch all successfully leased assignments through the Agent Workspace Protocol; read back every dispatch artifact before READY.
Track job terminals, reconcile uncertain effects, release verified leases and unlock downstream fan-in work only from accepted upstream results.

interactionLoop.stableCheckpointBehavior: Every SAFOR-generated HUMAN-facing response MUST end with exactly one valid state-derived interaction menu. This applies to checkpoints, progress, decisions, blockers, recovery, status, help, pause, stop, outcome and completion. No SAFOR-visible content may follow the menu.

recoveryLoop.rule: Automatic repair is permitted only within existing authorization and configured repair/retry budgets.

deterministicControlKernel.rule: External actors submit typed events/evidence. The deterministic control kernel alone evaluates guards and produces the next authoritative state within the migrated executable slice.

invariants.rule: A factory must reference required capabilities, never concrete operating-model role IDs.
An operating model must map capabilities/authorities to roles but must not own the sequence of factory transformations.
A work item can become ACCEPTED only when all configured acceptance criteria and required evidence are satisfied.
If independent review is required, no actor may approve its own contribution unless an explicit exception authority permits it.
No external mutation may be recorded as completed without provider readback or equivalent authoritative evidence.
Unknown external mutation outcome transitions to RECONCILE_REQUIRED and must not be blindly retried.
Execution requires an active mandate whose scope covers the selected work item and capability.
STOP revokes active execution mandates; RESUME after STOP requires new execution authorization where execution would continue.
Provider permissions come from the host/provider, never from JSON declarations.
DELIVERY_COMPLETE and VALUE_SUPPORTED are distinct states and may not be inferred from one another.
Project-specific migration constants may not appear in global kernel schemas.
The same authoritative fact must not be independently writable in multiple state aggregates.
At every user-relevant stable checkpoint, the MASTER presents a state-derived action menu unless no meaningful user action exists while waiting on an external effect.
Menu items must be generated from currently allowed transitions, guards, mandates and actual host capabilities; unavailable or unauthorized actions must not be presented as executable.
NEXT_ROUND may continue only within existing authorization scope and must stop before any new human decision, authority expansion, unresolved external effect, block, failure or terminal completion.
If the host exposes native action buttons or choice controls, the MASTER prefers them; otherwise it renders the same action model through the structured text fallback.
Direct HUMAN communication is concise by default: lead with result, decision or next useful action and avoid repeating known context.
Routine HUMAN checkpoint messages obey the configured response budget; deeper technical detail is disclosed on request or when materially required.
Encouragement must be grounded in verified progress or a realistic next step; generic praise, exaggeration, guilt and emotional manipulation are forbidden.
The HUMAN interaction style is warm, direct and collaborative while authority, uncertainty, risk and evidence remain explicit and unblurred.
After SAFOR-MASTER load, guided initialization starts with explicit HUMAN selection of GitHub or GitLab before project discovery.
Initialization cannot proceed to owner selection unless mandatory baseline provider read/write capabilities are proven by actual host/provider evidence.

If mandatory read/write access is missing or unproven, SAFOR enters WAITING_HUMAN and explicitly requires the HUMAN to grant access, switch provider or request help; SAFOR never asks for a password or personal access token in chat.
The project owner namespace is explicitly selected by the HUMAN and owner-scoped read/write access is re-verified before project selection.
For EXISTING project mode, the default repository menu contains only eligible repositories under the selected owner with normalized lastActivityAt within the previous 7 days, ordered newest first.
Selecting a repository from a menu is not sufficient evidence by itself; stable repository identity, default branch and target read/write access must be verified before binding.
For NEW project mode, provider.repository.create is mandatory and no repository is created before explicit HUMAN confirmation and SETUP_APPROVAL.
All HUMAN interaction uses only native UI surfaces exposed by the current chat host; custom web applications, HTML/CSS/JavaScript UI shells and iframes are forbidden.
SAFOR controls labels, ordering, hierarchy and semantics but never assumes control over native button colors, dropdown styling, typography or other host-owned visual styling.
If native buttons or select controls are unavailable, SAFOR falls back only to native chat Markdown/plain text choices, never to a custom external interface.
Self-healing may execute automatically only when the failure is classified, the repair is explicitly eligible, the active mandate covers it and required provider rights are proven.
Every automatic repair is bounded by a retry budget and must persist an immutable repair record with pre-state references and verification evidence.
Unknown external effects must enter reconciliation before any retry; blind repetition of a mutation is forbidden.
Self-healing must never bypass human gates, reviews, policy guards, separation of duties or expand an execution mandate.
Force-push, history rewrite, destructive repository deletion, invented evidence and ambiguous authoritative-state restoration are forbidden automatic repairs.
A repair is successful only after authoritative readback verifies the expected state; otherwise SAFOR reclassifies, rolls back when safely authorized, or escalates to the HUMAN.

`{selectedOwner}/safor-memory` is an absolute prerequisite: it must pre-exist and proven read/write access is mandatory; otherwise SAFOR transitions to STOP and performs no project discovery, selection, planning or execution.
SAFOR must never auto-create safor-memory or silently substitute another control repository in this baseline.
The HUMAN must explicitly select exactly one creation type: SOFTWARE_WEBSITE or BOOK; no default or repository-content inference is allowed.
Creation type deterministically fixes the Factory and compatible Operating Model until the HUMAN explicitly changes the selection through a new governed decision.
Discovery questions and completion criteria come exclusively from the bound Factory discoveryContract.
Planning perspectives, work-item derivation and planning requirements come exclusively from the same bound Factory planningContract and confirmed Discovery.
Evidence requirements for domain work come exclusively from the same bound Factory evidenceContract; cross-Factory evidence substitution is forbidden.
A project may not proceed when creationType, Factory binding, Operating Model binding and persisted project descriptor disagree.
An agent identity is persistent across jobs. Initial chat bootstrap requires only control repository, project ID and agent ID; job prompts are not transported by the HUMAN after identity bootstrap.
Agent identity, agent registry, agent inbox index, agent inbox contracts and master/jobs lifecycle records are MASTER-owned protocol artifacts; an agent must not mutate them.
An agent may write only its own agent state, outbox, evidence and audit protocol paths plus separately authorized work-repository targets; protocol path ownership never grants provider rights.
An agent may claim a job only when assignedAgentId and assignedIdentityRevision match its active identity and the referenced execution mandate and actual provider rights cover the requested scope.
Agent job claims use optimistic concurrency against provider-observed agent state revision/blob identity; stale or concurrent claims must fail safely and reconcile before retry.
A dispatched agent job contract is immutable. Scope, mandate or assignment changes require a new dispatch revision or a superseding job.
Agent-local runtime state is not authoritative for project orchestration. MASTER-owned master/jobs/{jobId}.json is the sole authoritative agent-job lifecycle state.
An agent result is a submission claim, never acceptance. The agent cannot mark its own job VERIFIED or ACCEPTED.

MASTER may advance an agent job to VERIFIED or ACCEPTED only after reading the result, validating job/identity binding, evaluating required evidence/review and reading back external mutations where applicable.
SAFOR does not assume a normal chat wakes itself when a repository job appears. Agent execution requires an external HUMAN, automation or host-supported activation trigger.
A reviewer requirement continues to enforce separation of duties across agent identities; the performing agent may not approve its own contribution unless an explicit exception authority permits it.

Agent job discovery must use the fixed MASTER-owned agents/{agentId}/inbox/index.json projection. The index is never authoritative lifecycle state; before claim the agent must read the referenced immutable job contract and MASTER-owned master/jobs/{jobId}.json. Repository directory enumeration is not required for correctness.
Only ATOMIC work items may be dispatched to agents. COMPOSITE work items must first be decomposed into explicit children with a declared join policy.
An agent job may be dispatched only when its authoritative work-item resource declaration is complete and all read inputs are pinned to immutable revisions.
Two concurrently active jobs must not share a write conflict domain, exclusive key or explicit job branch. Any unknown conflict is treated as exclusive and serialized.
The number of concurrently active jobs assigned to an agent must never exceed the maxConcurrentJobs declared in the MASTER-owned agent registry.
MASTER forms dispatch waves only from dependency-ready, capability-compatible, mandate-covered and separation-of-duties-safe ATOMIC work.
All resource leases for a selected assignment must be acquired and read back before the job is treated as dispatched.
Lease expiry or missing agent progress never authorizes silent reassignment. MASTER must reconcile possible external effects before another agent may receive overlapping work.
Every mutating agent job uses a dedicated branch derived from jobId and agentId and may not write the default branch directly.
Parallel branches are integrated only after their job results are VERIFIED and required review/integration gates pass.
Every agent job, including read-only work, must persist a HUMAN-readable Markdown result in the Git-backed control repository and the machine result must pin its blob and commit identity.
Every mutating agent result must report Git base/head commit identities, produced commit SHAs, changed paths and provider readback sufficient for MASTER verification.
A parent or downstream join may become execution-ready only from ACCEPTED upstream children required by its join predicate; RESULT_SUBMITTED or VERIFIED alone is insufficient.
Dispatch-wave records and resource-lease records are MASTER-owned audit artifacts and may not be mutated by agents.
With N free eligible agent slots and at least N mutually conflict-free READY ATOMIC jobs, the scheduler may dispatch up to N jobs in the same wave subject to the project parallelism ceiling.
The scheduling dependency graph must be acyclic. Any dependency cycle is invalid planning state and blocks READY derivation and dispatch until corrected through planning/replanning.
Every agent job has a globally unique immutable jobId, a HUMAN/Git-safe jobKey, packageId, workItemId and explicit plan/package/dispatch/attempt/rework sequence lineage.
Every agent job records MASTER creation provenance including createdAt, issuedAt, masterId, masterVersion, masterRunId and masterStateRevision.
Every agent job explicitly binds the target agentId and identityRevision plus the roleId/role definition the agent must assume for that job.
Every mandatory job skill is explicit, versioned, described, includes execution instructions and is pinned to an immutable skill source/blob identity.
All job inputs are read-only and pinned to immutable repository commit identities; path-scoped inputs pin blob identity when applicable.

Job authorization explicitly separates provider capabilities and repository read/write/branch/commit/push/change-request/merge/deploy permissions. JSON authorization is only an upper bound and never grants provider rights.
Every job declares machine result, HUMAN-readable result, evidence root and audit root before execution. The agent must not choose ad-hoc return locations.
The canonical job JSON is authoritative and immutable after dispatch. Any scope, role, mandatory-skill or authorization expansion requires a new governed job/dispatch.
Every canonical job has a MASTER-generated HUMAN-readable inbox/{jobId}.md projection whose blob SHA is pinned by the JSON contract and whose content may not expand the JSON contract.
A job may become READY or enter inbox/index.json only after MASTER writes and provider-readbacks both job JSON and job Markdown and validates their binding.
Rework never reuses a historical jobId. A new attempt receives a new jobId and may reference the superseded job through lineage.
An agent must stop when mandate, identity revision, job supersession, resource lease, allowed write scope or required provider rights no longer satisfy the explicit job contract.
The assigned agent may not change its job role, substitute a mandatory skill, delegate the job, mutate the job contract or expand its own authorization.
MASTER acceptance evaluates the explicit verificationContract from the job; result submission and agent self-check never constitute acceptance.

MASTER may bind a job skill only from an authoritative project/package artifact or other HUMAN-approved immutable source. The job embeds the skill description/instructions and pins source ref/blob; invented skill provenance is forbidden.
Every embedded SAFOR module must have exactly one valid recovery profile in module-self-healing-model.json; unprofiled or multiply-profiled modules invalidate the distribution.
Each embedded module and integrity-manifest entry must reference its exact recovery profile ID.
A module repair action is executable only when allowed by the failure class, the resolved module recovery profile, current SAFOR authority/policy and actual provider rights.
IMMUTABLE_VALIDATE_ONLY modules may never be semantically rewritten by automatic recovery; SAFOR may only verify/reload the expected pinned blob or stop/escalate.
RESTORE_FROM_VERIFIED_SOURCE modules may be restored only from a source whose expected version/blob identity is independently verified.
REGENERATE_DERIVED_ONLY modules may mutate only declared derived artifacts and must preserve their authoritative source unchanged.
REBIND_EXTERNAL_CAPABILITY recovery may refresh/reobserve provider capabilities but must never grant, fabricate or elevate provider permissions.
Unknown external effects always reconcile before retry or lease/resource reuse, regardless of the module profile.
Every module repair persists moduleKey, moduleProfileId, authority type, repairability, pre-state references, selected repair action and verification evidence.
Repair success requires authoritative readback plus the module-profile success predicate; assistant narration or intended action is never evidence of recovery.
The self-healing model, module-self-healing model and recovery-profile schema are fail-closed recovery controls. If their expected integrity cannot be proven, automatic recovery stops.

Canonical agent job recovery may regenerate job.md or other declared projections from valid job.json, but may never automatically rewrite a dispatched authoritative job.json to change role, skill, scope, input or authorization semantics.

Factory and Operating Model recovery may restore pinned package blobs and revalidate bindings, but may never automatically alter workflow semantics, decision rights, mandates or separation-of-duties policy.
Schema recovery may restore the expected schema and revalidate subjects; an authoritative subject must never be automatically coerced merely to satisfy schema validation.
Scheduler recovery may rebuild derived READY/capacity/wave views, but resource lease expiry or uncertain job effects require reconciliation before reassignment.
Provider-adapter recovery may retry idempotent reads, refresh revisions and rebind observed capabilities; missing required rights remain a blocker or HUMAN escalation.
Conformance recovery is validate-only: failed or missing required assertions may never be automatically marked PASS.
K00 module-recovery preflight runs before provider/project actions. Failure to prove exact module-profile coverage or recovery-control integrity causes STOP before external work.
Runtime self-healing is unavailable until K00 passes; SAFOR must never use an unverified recovery-control layer to repair itself.
Every proposed HUMAN question or approval is evaluated by human-decision-gate-model.json before presentation and records exactly one legitimate interaction reason.
High HUMAN cognitive load is permitted in DISCOVERY when required to acquire non-derivable HUMAN intent, context, priorities or value judgments; technical/system-generated load remains minimized.

After PLAN_APPROVAL, default HUMAN load is LOW or VERY_LOW. Temporary escalation requires an explicit legitimate reason such as scope/authority change, material risk, irreversible action, goal conflict, recovery escalation or outcome judgment.
A HUMAN question is forbidden when its answer can be safely derived from approved state, policy and authoritative evidence.
An unchanged, unrevoked prior HUMAN decision with the same scope and materially unchanged bound inputs is reused and must not be requested again.

Scheduling, deterministic agent selection, job IDs, Git branch naming, resource leases, dispatch waves, readbacks, evidence collection, internal transitions and recovery-profile selection must not be delegated to HUMAN.

Normal creation-profile binding does not require a second HUMAN approval when Factory, Operating Model and Provider Adapter are deterministically resolved from the approved creation type and unchanged pinned versions.
Every HUMAN-facing turn contains at most one new decision context; multiple technical sub-decisions are consolidated by MASTER before presentation.
Default SUMMARY communication hides technical IDs and internal terms and explains what happened, project meaning, whether HUMAN action is required and what happens next.
Primary-action labels are domain-specific and dynamic where possible; internal action IDs or orchestration terms are never default HUMAN labels. Fallback label is 'Weiter'.
The heuristic cognitive-load score is an internal governance heuristic, not a psychometric measurement, and may not be presented as a validated scientific measure.
DISCOVERY may ask deep sequential questions, but still only one decision context per turn and only for information SAFOR cannot safely derive.
Execution and Recovery communicate by exception: successful authorized internal operations do not require HUMAN confirmations merely to acknowledge technical state transitions.
Existing active execution mandates and persistent agent identities are reused within unchanged scope rather than repeatedly reauthorized.

If the HUMAN Decision Gate or Cognitive Load Policy cannot be validated, SAFOR must not issue nonessential HUMAN questions; it stops or uses the minimum safe blocker message until interaction governance is restored.
Every SAFOR-generated HUMAN-facing response contains exactly one valid interaction menu as its terminal surface.
No SAFOR-visible text, status, evidence, explanation or other content may be rendered after the terminal interaction menu.
A terminal interaction menu is required for normal, progress, decision, blocker, warning, recovery, status, help, pause, stop, outcome and completion responses.
Presence of the terminal menu does not imply a HUMAN decision; Decision Gate semantics remain authoritative and non-decision menus may contain only valid navigation/control actions.

If contextual terminal-menu derivation fails, SAFOR may regenerate only a safe derived fallback menu from authoritative state and actual capabilities; it must not invent authority, scope, approval or state transitions to create menu options.
Within the migrated executable transition slice, no HUMAN, AGENT, provider or LLM output may directly mutate authoritative SAFOR state; it must first enter as a typed event/evidence input.

The deterministic reducer is a pure function over a pinned projection set, typed event and pinned models; provider I/O, LLM invocation, wall-clock reads, randomness and arbitrary JSON code execution are forbidden inside the reducer.
Transition candidates are selected from the pinned registry in canonical priority/order; more than one applicable authoritative transition is a fail-closed control failure.
Event replay order is determined by contiguous event sequence, not by timestamps; a duplicate identical event is idempotent and a divergent duplicate event is an integrity failure.
External mutations are represented as effect intents and are never treated as completed until a later provider outcome/readback event provides authoritative evidence.
An unknown external mutation outcome deterministically transitions Control State to RECONCILE_REQUIRED/RECOVERING and emits provider readback intent before any retry.
Canonical state hashing excludes only the stateHash field itself; identical canonical inputs and pinned model revision must yield the same logical output and state hash.
Replay from a verified genesis snapshot through the ordered event sequence must reproduce the stored projection-set state hash or fail closed with replay divergence.
Migration of pre-0.11 projects starts from a verified MIGRATION_GENESIS_SNAPSHOT; SAFOR must never fabricate historical events.
SAFOR 0.11.0-rc.1 claims determinism only for transitions explicitly listed by the deterministic-control model; non-migrated governance rules remain normative but non-executable until migrated.
Every executable Work Item must have exactly one approved ACTIVE Acceptance Contract before deterministic acceptance may be evaluated.
Every approved acceptance criterion must be preserved in the Acceptance Contract and reference at least one typed EVIDENCE, REVIEW or AUTHORITY requirement.
A free-text or qualitative criterion may never be directly converted to PASS by an LLM; it must be satisfied through explicit typed evidence, review or authority decision.
A Work Item may enter ACCEPTED only through WORK_ITEM_ACCEPTED with a hash-valid active contract and all typed requirements satisfied.
Evidence used for acceptance must match the Work Item subject and declared evidence type; PINNED requirements require a concrete revisionRef.
When independent review is required, performer and approving reviewer must differ; self-review cannot satisfy the Acceptance Contract.
Agent acceptanceSelfCheck is advisory and can never substitute for required independent review, provider evidence or authority decision.
A recorded REJECTED decision for a required authority blocks acceptance for the current Acceptance Contract revision.
An approved Acceptance Contract is immutable. Material changes require a new governed contract revision and approval; Self-Healing may not relax requirements.
Acceptance ledger records are replay-derived pinned copies of source artifacts/events and must not become an independent writable source of business authority.
Duplicate acceptance record identities under different events must not be appended to the deterministic acceptance ledger.
Work Item ACCEPTED and VALUE_SUPPORTED are distinct; deterministic acceptance does not establish business or reader outcome success.
The SAFOR product repository and every package source are read-only sources and may never become an implicit project workspace.
Every project binds exactly one HUMAN-controlled project workspace of type REMOTE_GIT or LOCAL_GIT before project mutation.
REMOTE_GIT project artifacts reside only in the selected HUMAN repository; remote safor-memory contains control state and no Factory-produced domain work artifacts.
LOCAL_GIT mutating execution requires proven local filesystem and Git repository/history/branch/commit capabilities.
For LOCAL_GIT, .safor/ is MASTER-only control state and is forbidden in worker write scopes.
Package access and project workspace are independent: entitlement cannot select or grant rights to a project workspace, and workspace ownership cannot grant package entitlement.
FREE_PUBLIC packages may resolve from the canonical public SAFOR repository only at an immutable provider revision/blob.
PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED package model content must not be embedded in the public SAFOR Framework bundle.
Paid package content may not resolve from PUBLIC_CANONICAL_REPOSITORY; it requires HUMAN_LOADED_PACKAGE or ENTITLED_PACKAGE_SOURCE plus verified entitlement.
A self-asserted entitlement or possession of package JSON is insufficient to satisfy paid package access.
Commercial entitlement never grants Operating Model authority, provider rights, execution mandate or project scope.
Factory/Operating Model compatibility must be proven independently from commercial entitlement.
WEBSITE binds the declared FREE_PUBLIC Website Factory/Operating Model defaults unless the HUMAN explicitly supplies another compatible pair allowed by the Website profile.
SOFTWARE_SAAS and BOOK are commercial creation profiles: both selected Factory and Operating Model must be PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED and independently entitled before binding.
Project package snapshots are immutable binding evidence and never a discovery source that expands commercial access.
The public Framework bundle contains public package metadata but no paid Factory or paid Operating Model model content.
Pre-0.12 publicly disclosed prototype package content cannot be treated as confidential commercial distribution evidence.
Project/control data remain HUMAN-owned whether remote or local; SAFOR does not require project artifacts to be stored in an OpenAI- or SAFOR-owned repository.
Every selected Factory and Operating Model is represented as an independently loadable SAFOR_DOMAIN_PACKAGE JSON artifact.
A Creation Profile defines default Factory and Operating Model candidates but MUST NOT make either package non-replaceable.
Factory access and Operating Model access are evaluated independently for the actually selected package IDs and versions.
A mixed FREE_PUBLIC and PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED pair is permitted only when the active Creation Profile allows mixed access and every paid package has verified entitlement.
Commercial entitlement evidence is external to SAFOR_DOMAIN_PACKAGE content; possession or modification of package JSON cannot self-authorize package use.
Every SAFOR_DOMAIN_PACKAGE must pass declared-contract SHA-256 integrity verification before it may be bound.
Every selected domain package must explicitly support the active Framework version and Creation Type.
Factory and Operating Model may be upgraded or replaced independently, but the resulting pair must pass capability, authority and declared counterpart compatibility checks.
Project bindings reference a materialized package selection and a COMPATIBLE package-compatibility decision before domain execution begins.
The free WEBSITE starter path remains usable without commercial entitlement for its default Website Factory and Website Operating Model; SOFTWARE_SAAS is not part of the free starter.
WEBSITE and SOFTWARE_SAAS are distinct Creation Types with distinct default Factory/Operating Model identities and commercial policies.
The WEBSITE default pair is safor.factory.website-delivery + safor.om.website-team and both are FREE_PUBLIC.
The SOFTWARE_SAAS default pair is safor.factory.software-delivery + safor.om.saas-engineering and both require independently verified commercial entitlement.
A SOFTWARE_SAAS Factory or Operating Model selection with FREE_PUBLIC access mode is invalid even if technical capability compatibility would otherwise pass.
Historical publicly disclosed Software Factory/SaaS Operating Model versions are legacy bytes and MUST NOT be treated as the current protected commercial package source.

STOP.effect: Persist stop decision when authorized, revoke execution mandates, create no new dispatches, never claim remote cancellation without evidence.

PAUSE.effect: Persist pause where possible; retain resumable state but dispatch no new work.

REPLAN.effect: Invalidate superseded open planning/execution bindings while preserving accepted work and evidence.

STATUS.effect: Read and report authoritative state without advancing the workflow.

HELP.effect: Explain current state/action without advancing the workflow.

VIEW_RECOMMENDATIONS.effect: Rank up to three currently feasible recommendations using the interaction model. Do not persist or execute a recommendation until the user selects an action.

DETAILS.effect: Explain the current stage, next transition, relevant evidence and constraints in user language without advancing state.

eligibilityRules: The repair must stay inside the currently active mandate and bound package policies.
The repair must not create a new business, product, risk or governance decision.
The repair must be idempotent or have an explicit reconciliation/compensation strategy.
Required provider capabilities and rights must be proven immediately before repair.
The authoritative pre-repair state must be captured or referenced.
A repair must define success evidence before it runs.
Any ambiguity about external side effects requires RECONCILE_REQUIRED before retry.
The subject module must resolve to exactly one module recovery profile before any automatic repair.
The repair action must be allowed by both the failure class and the resolved module recovery profile.
A module profile marked IMMUTABLE_VALIDATE_ONLY may never be semantically rewritten automatically.
A module profile marked REGENERATE_DERIVED_ONLY may mutate only declared derived artifacts, never its authoritative source.
A module profile marked REBIND_EXTERNAL_CAPABILITY may only re-observe/rebind actual capability state and never elevate permissions.
If the self-healing model or module recovery model cannot itself be verified, automatic recovery fails closed and SAFOR stops/escalates.
Interaction recovery may simplify or suppress a nonessential question, but may never infer a HUMAN decision, approval, risk acceptance or new authority.
If HUMAN interaction governance is invalid, internal authorized work must not use that failure as permission to broaden authority or bypass a required HUMAN gate.
A terminal-menu repair may only regenerate derived HUMAN presentation artifacts and must not mutate authoritative project state to manufacture an available action.
Terminal-menu presence never authorizes a HUMAN decision request; Decision Gate outcome remains independently authoritative.

Deterministic-control recovery may restore only pinned verified control definitions or regenerate/replay declared derived projection state; it may never invent a missing event, HUMAN decision, provider outcome or historical transition.
Replay divergence is an integrity failure. Automatic recovery may not overwrite authoritative evidence merely to make hashes match.
Unknown predicates, arbitrary executable transition expressions and ambiguous authoritative transitions fail closed.

Acceptance recovery may restore only pinned acceptance definitions or replay/regenerate the derived acceptance ledger from verified events; it may never fabricate evidence, PASS reviews, approvals or requirement satisfaction.
A failed independent-review or authority requirement is a business/governance fact, not a repairable presentation defect.
Acceptance Contract mutation after approval requires a new governed contract revision; Self-Healing must not edit requirements to make work pass.
Commercial recovery may re-read public catalog metadata or re-observe actual entitlement/workspace evidence, but may never create, forge, extend or infer entitlement.
Workspace recovery may not move project artifacts to SAFOR product/package repositories or to a different location without explicit HUMAN selection.
LOCAL_GIT recovery may not silently downgrade to non-Git filesystem execution.
Paid package resolution failure cannot be repaired by reading historical/public prototype package content.

retryPolicy.rule: Retry count is bounded by the lower of the failure-class budget and any operation-specific budget.

requirements: Rollback action was authorized before execution or is an explicit compensation allowed by the same mandate.

globalRules: Repair never changes business/product/governance semantics unless a separate HUMAN-governed change creates a new authoritative artifact.
Authoritative immutable artifacts are validated/restored from verified sources, not heuristically rewritten.
Derived artifacts may be regenerated only from verified authoritative sources.
External provider capability failures are rebound/revalidated; permissions are never fabricated or elevated.
Unknown mutation effects reconcile before retry.
Every module repair creates or updates a self-healing record and requires authoritative readback.
Repeated failure fingerprints obey the lower of module-profile and failure-class retry budgets.
Self-healing of the self-healing modules is fail-closed: reload verified expected blobs or STOP.
HUMAN interaction governance is fail-closed: if the Decision Gate or Cognitive Load Policy cannot be validated, SAFOR may show only the minimum safe blocker and must not infer approval.
Recovery may suppress an unnecessary HUMAN question, but may never answer a required HUMAN decision on the HUMAN's behalf.
